    int from, to, flow, cap, next;
} edges[200005];

int edgeCount = 0;
int head[505], parent[505], visited[505];
int source = 501, sink = 502, totalFlow = 0;
int n, t, depth[505];

    edges[++edgeCount] = {u, v, 0, capacity, head[u]};
    head[u] = edgeCount;
    edges[++edgeCount] = {v, u, 0, 0, head[v]};
    head[v] = edgeCount;
}

bool bfs() {
    queue<int> q;
    memset(visited, 0, sizeof(visited));
    memset(depth, 0, sizeof(depth));
    q.push(source);
    visited[source] = true;
    depth[source] = 1;
    
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (int i = head[u]; i; i = edges[i].next) {
            int v = edges[i].to;
            if (!visited[v] && edges[i].flow < edges[i].cap) {
                parent[v] = i;
                q.push(v);
                visited[v] = true;
                depth[v] = depth[u] + 1;
                if (v == sink) return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;

        int v = edges[i].to;

            int delta = dfs(v, min(pushed, edges[i].cap - edges[i].flow));
            if (!delta) depth[v] = 0;
            edges[i].flow += delta;
            edges[((i - 1) ^ 1) + 1].flow -= delta;
            pushed -= delta;
            if (!pushed) break;
        }
    }
    return flowLimit - pushed;
}

    while (bfs()) {
        totalFlow += dfs(source, 1000000007);
    }

                    if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && isdigit(gridA[nx][ny]) && 
                        distABCD[i][j][nx][ny] > distABCD[i][j][x][y] + 1 && 
                        distABCD[i][j][x][y] < distFromZ[x][y]) {
                        distABCD[i][j][nx][ny] = distABCD[i][j][x][y] + 1;
                        bfsQueue.push({nx, ny});
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Add edges based on distance constraints
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                    if (distABCD[i][j][k][l] <= min(distFromZ[k][l], t)) {
                        addEdge((i - 1) * n + j, (k - 1) * n + l + 100, 10000);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Read gridB and connect to sink

        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            cin >> gridB[i][j];
            if (isdigit(gridB[i][j])) {
                addEdge((i - 1) * n + j + 100, sink, gridB[i][j] - '0');
